part.text:
Fixed the Node.js adapter to honor `config.timeoutErrorMessage`, matching the browser adapter behavior.

`lib/adapters/http.js:425` now uses the custom message when provided, falling back to the default. The timeout-related tests, including `should respect the timeoutErrorMessage property`, pass. Two unrelated failures in the full suite stem from external network access.
